You need an off road vehicle to drive in the visitor/guest parking lot. Apparently not a priority, while staff have nice, gated, paved and shaded parking spots.

visited Sriphat Medical Center to consult a dermatologist, but my doctor was actually at the Medical Excellence Building. The receptionist staff at Sriphat were very welcoming and kind they  helped me find the right location. …

The most disorganized, irresponsible and unprofessional medical facility I have ever been to in Thailand. They say they'll call back with important results, they never do, and when you call THEM asking even after providing patient number …

Nice building and conveniently located. However very poor management, not satisfied with our experience at the fertility clinic. Ice cold waiting room conditions. Nurses kept asking my wife the same information on each visit. Students watch …

The clinic itself, nurse, reception, check up and doctor service are very good. They take care about you and help you with guidance almost by hand and advices. As there are other patients in need, take your time for waiting, it’s not a fast food store. need to plan few hours ahead for clinic visit.

Booked an appointment with a dermatologist and they said the fee would be 300baht + (starting from) 300baht doctor fee. I was in there for 5 minutes, no special treatment, but was charged 500baht doctors fee. When I questioned why it wasn't …

I went there for a mammography, the service is pretty good. The price is around 3,200 baht. Recommend to call and make a reservation in advance due to this setting follows Thai government public holidays.

I had Lasik surgery here. The booking process was quick, the price was good and affordable. The doctor and nurses provided excellent service and advice. There was ample parking and clean restrooms. They even called to remind me beforehand. Chiang Mai University staff get special rates.
Wait time is 4 hours for a consultation. What a joke.

I called at 3:54 PM to schedule an appointment with the doctor, not to see him right away, just to book a "future" appointment!!! The person who answered said, "They've probably turned off all the computers. Could you give me some details...?"

Seriously... just say what you want politely. Saying "they've turned off all the computers at this time"... why? I hope you never get sick. I don't want anyone to experience service like you.
The phone should be more modern; it's very difficult to get through. And the nurses at the front counter of the OPD on the 3rd floor tend to scold patients; they're not pleasant at all.
The doctors and nurses are great, but the parking is a real pain. Every time I come, I feel lost and alone. Haha.

The person who answered the phone spoke as if they didn't want to work anymore. They said whatever they wanted without considering the company's image, not even realizing they were in a customer service job.
They didn't bother to ask for my name, surname, or HN number, and didn't even try to verify my information or help me. They just said, "Isn't that your appointment date…?" Is your system slow or something? Even the LINE message said the appointment had been postponed. They just kept saying, "What is this?" What does that even mean? Seriously, have they ever received any etiquette training? Anyone thinking of calling this number before treatment, be prepared. No matter how polite you are, the person answering the phone will be rude.
The entrance as Google map advice is wrong.
The place is clean, safe, and the service is excellent and fast throughout the process. I really liked it. The price is also reasonable.

text: Everything is good except for very little parking. It's like a government hospital. It's very difficult to find a parking spot.
The doctor took very good care of me.
Waited for 4 hours. Extremely poor management.

- 🚗 From the main road, go into the soi (side street) for about 300 meters, it will be on the left.

- Plenty of parking available.

- Parking tickets are stamped; free for parking less than half an hour.

At this hospital, the doctor came in shifts. They just examined my skin, asked a few questions, didn't even look at my face, didn't do any lab tests, and only gave me allergy medication. Why would I come here? Parking is difficult, and waiting for the shuttle van is a long time. It's a huge waste of time. I'm completely fed up.

Various medical clinics here.
Bone scans and other scans available also.

Health check-up: ฿7,7XX
I had blood pressure since the first measurement.
I had blood drawn and everything was tested, and I'm waiting to see the doctor.

The doctor, who was about 35-40 years old, reported normal results and said I was in good health. I spoke with him for about two minutes.

I got the results home and read them. I found high cholesterol, high fat, and thick blood. I had muscle ruptures.

I want to know if the doctor was serious about his job. Giving a patient this kind of result is a misdiagnosis.

I took the results to another doctor. The doctor said it was as I had stated and advised me to start a diet and medication.

You charge such a high price; you should provide better service. I'm very disappointed with this place and will only go once. I will never go back!!! It's terrible!!!

text: I made a huge mistake choosing to come here. Private prices, government management, terrible service, and a very long wait.

The doctor lacked emotional maturity and judgment. I waited a long time only to hear rude remarks from the doctor, even though I paid in cash and wasn't receiving free treatment. The doctor spoke to the patient as if they were begging for free care. One visit was enough.

We regularly bring our seniors home from this medical center. It's a very diverse medical facility with many departments and clinics. The staff here are excellent and provide friendly service, especially to the elderly. The doctors are lovely and answer all our questions. When you arrive, be sure to register with the staff first to save time. Importantly, it's best to bring several seniors along; don't let them come alone. Parking is limited and difficult to find. (Chiang Mai news, you know!)

The doctors and nurses take good care of me. They always ask me if I can handle it. The cost is not too expensive compared to other private hospitals. The only downside is that there are a lot of people, so you might have to wait a bit. The building looks old.
They have looked after me for 10 years. They are wonderful.
The Suan Dok Center of Excellence is a clean place with ample parking and excellent service.
The place is clean, the service is good, and it's easy to access.
In short, it was awful. I won't go there again.

text: The parking lot is terrible.
Please go somewhere else if you have a choice.
Finding a parking spot was very difficult; we had to wait a while. However, the security guards were polite and helpful. I wouldn't recommend driving to the doctor alone.

I went to see the doctor in the evening. The doctor looked very young and lovely. I've seen the orthopedic and nephrology doctors at GMC before, and their first words were always, "Hello, Mom. How are you feeling today?" It warmed my heart. …
Parking space is limited and mostly used by employees; significant improvements are needed.
Overall, very good. The only thing that needs serious improvement is the parking lot. Most of the parking spaces are for hospital staff.
Excellent service from the staff. The place is clean and safe.

I drove up, and one side said "Executive Parking," the other said "Staff Parking." I had to shout to ask where to park before they'd open the barrier. I'd already received my parking ticket, so why all the barriers? When I got out, wow, there are a lot of executives here. They only just asked which floor I was on, if I had an appointment card, and if I could park there. Why didn't they put a sign in the purple area saying "Executive Parking"?! I was so confused! Why didn't they write it clearly like the executive parking?! Anyway, I have to get my ticket stamped.

The system was supposed to be good, but they said I could register online and go straight to the checkpoint. However, when I arrived, they said the system wasn't working well, so I had to register again just in case. The staff were very helpful and explained everything patiently. I'm giving 2 stars to the registration staff and deducting 3 points for the parking situation.
Horrible experience at this hospital I will never go back. I was treated very poorly
